#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static double cs[1 << 20], sn[1 << 20], csi[1 << 20], sni[1 << 20];

struct InputReader {
    std::istream& is;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int pos, size;

    InputReader(std::istream& input) : is(input), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatch");
            }
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

    int read() {
        if (size == -1) {
            throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatch");
        }
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            buf.resize(1024);
            is.read(&buf[0], buf.size());
            size = is.gcount();
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

void fft(std::vector<double>& a, std::vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = (int)a.size();
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = std::reverse(i << shift) >> shift;
        if (i < j) {
            std::swap(a[i], a[j]);
            std::swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            int w = (int)cs.size() / len;
            for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < half; j++, k += w) {
                double wA = inverse ? csi[half + j] : cs[half + j];
                double wB = inverse ? sni[half + j] : sn[half + j];
                double uA = a[i + j], uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + half] * wA - b[i + j + half] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + half] * wB + b[i + j + half] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + half] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + half] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

static void initialize_fft() {
    for (int len = 1; len <= (int)sizeof(cs) * 8; len <<= 1) {
        for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
            cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            csi[i] = cos(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            sni[i] = sin(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;

    std::vector<double> aReal(n), aImag(n), bReal(n), bImag(n), faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }

    fft(aReal, aImag, false);
    fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * 0.5;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag(i) = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = static_cast<long long>(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = static_cast<long long>(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = static_cast<long long>(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        res[i] = (int)(((aa % mod) + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    initialize_fft();
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(std::cin);

    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;

    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
    }

    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
    }
    std::cout << res << "\n";

    return 0;
}
